profile.name: Monkey D. Luffy

reasons.reason: Há traits ligados ao uso ou à evolução da Skill 2; seu acesso recebe prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: When using Skill 2: Class changes to Attacker(s). and ATK: Boosted by 30% for 20 second(s). (Cannot Stack)

reasons.reason: Há benefícios condicionados a HP acima de um limite; recuperação e manutenção de HP recebem prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: When your HP is 50% or more: Resist Stagger and Knockback.
When your HP is 50% or more: Boost capture speed by 50%. and Reduce damage received by 30%.
When your HP is 50% or more: Remove status effects and nullify status effects inflicted by enemy. and Recover 50% of percentage damage received from an enemy.

reasons.reason: Capturar tesouro ativa traits. O perfil considera esse benefício além da classe.

evidence.text: When you capture the Treasure: Recover HP by 30%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 20%.

profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text: Nullifies Shock and Entrance. and After holding down the normal attack button during the 1st hit of a normal attack combo: The 2nd hit of the attack changes into a counter attack that knocks enemies back. (Become temporarily invincible.) When counter succeeds: Recover HP by 30%.
When dodging, 100% chance to: Class changes to Defender(s). and SPD: Boosted by 20% for 10 second(s). (Cannot Stack)
When you start capturing Treasure: Class changes to Runner(s).
Power Gauge can be used (increases up to 5, but resets once KO'd). and Skill 2 transforms into "Gum-Gum Bajrang Gun" when Power Gauge is at max.
When in the Treasure Area: Reduce damage received by 30%. and Increase damage dealt by 20%.
When attacked by an enemy whose ATK is boosted: Recover HP by 5%. and Reduce damage received from Attackers by 20%.
Can ignore the enemy and refill the Treasure Gauge. and Recovers the Treasure Gauge 50% past its maximum amount.
When in the Treasure Area: Increase damage dealt by 30%. and Reduce damage received by 20%.
When attacking an enemy in a Treasure Area: Increase damage dealt by 30%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 3%.
While you are capturing Treasure: Resist Stagger, being Downed, and Knockback. and Reduce damage received by 20%.
When you Knockback an enemy: Increase DEF by 25% (increases up to 70% but resets once KO'd). and Boosts Power Gauge by 2.
When in the Treasure Area: Reduce damage received by 30%. and Resist Stagger and Knockback.
When using a skill transformed by the Power Gauge: Uses 5 unit(s) of the Power Gauge. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 50%.
When spawning: Boosts Power Gauge by 5.

When attacked by an enemy whose parameter(s) is boosted: Remove status effects applied to enemy that buff their target for a certain period of time. When this Trait activates, it also nullifies status effects applied to the enemy. Does not apply to invincibility. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 7%.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Defender presume defesa do próprio tesouro sem aliados próximos. Captura, tesouro inimigo e aliados próximos ficam desativados; outras condições usam 0,5 e eventos 0,25.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
